name: Spelljack Thug
body:
XP 3,200
Half-orc spelljack 8
CN Medium humanoid (human, orc)
Init +8; Senses Darkvision60 ft., Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 19 (+ 5 armor, +4 Dex), touch 14, flat-footed 15
hp 60 (8d8+ 16)
Fort +4, Ref +10, Will +7
Defensive Abilities evasion, spell shield (+ 2 to AC and all saves against spells and spell-like abilities), absorb magic

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 dagger +11, (1d4+ 5/19-20) or +1 dagger +9/+4 (1d4+ 11/19-20) and +1 dagger +9 (1d4+8/19-20)
Ranged dart bracers +10 (1d2)
Ranged Full Attack dart bracers +8/+3 (1d2) and dart bracers +8 (1d2)
Special Attacks sneak attack +3d6, steal magic
Spelljack Spells Prepared (CL 7th; concentration +10)

3rd–dispel magic, fly, greater stunning barrier (DC 16)
2nd–blur, cat’s grace*, cloying shadows (DC 15), dance ofdaggers, invisibility
1st–charm person (DC 14), clever distraction x2 (DC 14), disguise self, shield, vanish
0th (at will)–arcane mark, daze (DC 13), ghost sound (DC 13), resistance

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 18, Con 14, Int 16, Wis 13, Cha 12
Base Atk +6 CMB: +6 CMD 20
Feats Improved Initiative,Two-Weapon Fighting, Extra Expertise (daggercloud), Piranha Strike
Skills Acrobatics +11; Appraise +10; Bluff +12; Climb +7; Disable Device +19; Knowledge (local) +10; Sense Motive +12; Sleight of Hand +15; Spellcraft +14; Stealth +20; Perception +12
Languages Common, Orc, Elven, Draconic, Halfling
SQ trapfinding, detect magic, expertise: battle hardened, broadened horizons (fly, cat’s grace), deadly finesse
Combat Gear +1 dagger x2, 5 masterwork daggers, 6 daggers, +1 mithral chain shirt, cloak of elvenkind, potion ofinvisibility, potion of cure moderate wounds, wand of shield (15 charges), wand of fly (10 charges), rod of endless rope, dart bracers, boot knife

*The statistics presented include bonuses provided by cat’s grace.

ABOUT

A character steps from the shadows, dagger drawn and off-hand already active in casting a spell.
